observations: Silver and grey electronic keyboard with 61 keys.
The unit is wrapped in clear plastic film.
The brand 'YAMAHA' is visible on the left side of the control panel.
There is a central LCD screen and a large circular dial.
Model text is present on the top right corner but is unreadable due to blur and plastic wrap.
The keyboard is shown standing vertically against a wall; it is not powered on.

claims.evidence: The device is not shown powered on or being tested.
No power adapter is visible in the photos.
Requires a video with audio to confirm functional keys and speakers.

risks.risk: The specific model number significantly dictates the market value.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the model name (usually top right).
risks.if_unproven: at the price of the lowest-spec entry-level Yamaha PSR model

risks.risk: The LCD screen may be cracked or have failed segments.
risks.proof: A photo of the screen powered on.

risks.risk: Individual keys or buttons may be non-responsive.
risks.proof: A video of a chromatic scale being played and buttons being pressed.

risks.risk: The internal speakers may be blown or distorted.
risks.proof: A video with clear audio of the keyboard playing.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the model name printed on the top right of the keyboard.
A photo of the keyboard powered on showing the LCD screen.
A video of the keyboard being played to confirm all keys and speakers work.
A photo of the included power adapter.
response.reason: The brand is confirmed as Yamaha, but the specific model number is unreadable. Because Yamaha keyboards range from basic toys to professional workstations, the model is essential for a valid valuation.
